headline: Two credible current-price conditional candidates, two completed current-price passes, and one material surveillance correction. Cash models have improved. A repeatable selection advantage remains unproven.

cases.name: CMS Info Systems
cases.working_range_driver: Two recurring cash-investment paths, with the same 12× year-five owner-cash exit
cases.key_finding: The valuation is complete. Recurring investment around ₹200cr can support the working case. ₹250cr materially weakens it. Customer financing is included in cash use.
cases.reopen: An issuer cash schedule or equivalent primary evidence can support promotion at the same price. Focus on capital payments, customer-loan collections and recurring spend.
cases.price_source: Original NSE bhavcopy, verified bytes and issuer identity

cases.name: R Systems
cases.working_range_driver: 12× exit applied to year-five or following year-six owner cash
cases.key_finding: Observed cash generation is substantial. The model funds acquisition debt, operating liquidity, incentive awards and additional acquisition shares.
cases.reopen: Reevaluate near ₹210–220, or at the same price for evidence of 8% organic growth and 19.5% normalized cash margin. The final swap ratio is not an automatic veto.
cases.price_source: Original NSE bhavcopy, verified bytes and issuer identity

cases.name: Medi Assist
cases.working_range_driver: Single working scenario, 14× year-five operating owner cash
cases.key_finding: Seasonality explains the weak half-year cash figure. Normal tax and recurring software investment still leave a modest working return.
cases.reopen: Price around ₹210–230 with unchanged economics, or a supported increase in annual owner cash to about ₹120.5cr initially and ₹176.2cr in year five.
cases.price_source: Original NSE bhavcopy, verified bytes and issuer identity

cases.name: Accelya Solutions India
cases.display_disposition: Pass at current price · income alternative
cases.working_range_driver: Revised ₹5cr recurring funding assumption, with 12× and 14× year-five owner-cash exits
cases.key_finding: The review challenged an excessive recurring funding assumption. Revised cash is about ₹70.88 per share, still below the historical ₹80 dividend.
cases.reopen: Reassess collected cash, contract investment and parent-related balances. The favorable lease and collection normalization case is visible, alongside valuation sensitivities.
cases.price_source: Original NSE bhavcopy, verified bytes and issuer identity

cases.name: Cosmo First
cases.key_finding: The prior handoff omitted an 18 November state GST search disclosure. The original notice contains no quantified demand or finding of misconduct.
cases.reopen: Reconcile scope, potential economic exposure and operating effects before promotion. The old conditional price range is not an automatic trigger.
cases.price_source: Original NSE bhavcopy, verified bytes and issuer identity

review_scope: Dated research follow-through on the existing watch. No new schedule. Resolve corporate actions, distributions and post-publication execution timing before economic-return claims.
historical_validation_status: Old frozen source-price diagnostic did not establish selection advantage. Retrospective six-case reconstructions are not a blind backtest. Current discretionary process has no demonstrated prospective post-cost edge.
